Review the following code changes for correctness, security, architecture, and adherence to design intent. The diff, source files, review checklists, and design docs are provided as files via relevant_files — do not expect inline contents here.

## Task Scope

Review mode: mid-implementation

In scope (review these):
- Task 1: Client receipt handling — status: done (client.py and tests/test_client.py)

Out of scope (pending — DO NOT flag as missing):
- Task 2: Provider receipts — status: pending (separate provider repository; not part of this diff)

The design docs describe the full end state. Pending tasks are expected gaps — treat their absence as intentional, not a finding. Still flag real issues within the in-scope client increment, including interface-contract problems that future provider work will depend on.

## Spec context summary

Feature "enhanced-settings": ordinary saves must keep working with the supported provider at eval-release; the enhanced UI is disabled by default. The change adds an application "receipt" to the save protocol — the client now sends `require_receipt: True` and requires the provider response to include `applied: True`, raising RuntimeError otherwise. Provider-side honoring of `require_receipt` is Task 2, out of scope. Main must stay independently releasable (the client increment must not break against a provider that has not yet shipped receipt support).
